root_cause_label: Infinite loop in solution causes test runner timeout
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent generated a staircase-building algorithm with contradictory state machine logic causing an infinite loop at runtime, then failed to diagnose or fix it across multiple retries, each time hitting the 120-second timeout without modifying the code.
t_err_evidence: Step 4 creates solution.js with towardsGoldAction() that has contradictory logic: when adjacent to gold and level < 7, it moves away to fetch blocks but the carrying/drop/move state never converges, creating an infinite oscillation cycle.
t_commit_evidence: Step 5 runs the test runner and it times out after 120 seconds with only 'DEBUG: invoking game.run(3)' output. The agent then reads the code at step 9 but makes no changes and reruns the same failing test at step 10, confirming the failure is locked in.
t_surface_evidence: Step 5 terminal output: 'The command timed out after 120.0 seconds' with exit code -1, indicating the game never completed any of the 3 required trials.
trigger_explanation: The plan to build a staircase to gold was conceptually correct but the generated code's towardsGoldAction logic contains a structural flaw: when adjacent to gold and not carrying, it moves away to fetch a block, but the state machine never increments level and re-checks, causing the agent to oscillate between moving away and being called back, never making staircase progress.
